question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

The old Adam

options.text: The evil or reckless side of human nature

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"The old Adam"** refers to the evil or reckless side of human nature. (मानव स्वभाव का बुरा या लापरवाह पक्ष)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite his efforts to reform,** the old Adam** in him often led him to make poor decisions.
 
 
 
• **"The evil or reckless side of human nature" **is the innate tendency towards wrongdoing or impulsive behavior. (मानव स्वभाव का बुरा या लापरवाह पक्ष)
 
 
• **Example: **The old Adam surfaced when he faced temptation, showing his true nature.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **An old strategy in action **(एक पुरानी रणनीति क्रिया में): A technique or plan that has been used for a long time.

 
 
• **Example: **He decided to use an old strategy in action to win the negotiations.
 
 
 
• **Beginning of a new journey **(नई यात्रा की शुरुआत): The start of something new or a new phase in life.
 
 
• **Example: **Graduation marked the beginning of a new journey for all the students.
 
 
 
• **A person with orthodox thinking** (रूढ़िवादी सोच वाला व्यक्ति): Someone who holds traditional or conventional beliefs.
 
 
• **Example: **He is known to be a person with orthodox thinking, adhering strictly to traditional values.
 
 

31:Tc54,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
